# AllToolss — Unified Developer, Security, PDF, Finance & AI Multi-Tool Suite

> AllToolss (https://alltoolss.com) is a high-performance, privacy-first web platform featuring 40+ production-grade online developer tools, passive VAPT security scanners, ATS resume checkers, 25+ PDF document operations, financial calculators, and astronomical calendar systems. All computations run in-server and client-side with 100% memory isolation and zero external third-party data tracking.

Canonical tool URLs live under https://alltoolss.com/tools/{slug}. Legacy paths 301-redirect to those canonicals.

## Core Capabilities & Tool Directory

### Developer Utilities
- [JSON Formatter & Validator](https://alltoolss.com/tools/json-formatter): Fast JSON tree visualization, minify, syntax check, and error highlight.
- [Regex Tester & Debugger](https://alltoolss.com/tools/regex-tester): Interactive regular expression testing with cheat sheet and match explanations.
- [JWT Decoder & Inspector](https://alltoolss.com/tools/jwt-decoder): Parse JWT headers, payload claims, expiration timestamps, and signature verification.
- [AI SQL Query Generator](https://alltoolss.com/tools/sql-generator): Natural language to optimized SQL queries for PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, and SQL Server.
- [Gitignore Generator](https://alltoolss.com/tools/gitignore-generator): Production-ready .gitignore configurations for 50+ languages and frameworks.
- [Base64 Encoder & Decoder](https://alltoolss.com/tools/base64-encoder-decoder): Encode and decode strings, images, and binary payloads.
- [UUID v4 Generator](https://alltoolss.com/tools/uuid-generator): Bulk RFC-compliant UUID v4 generation with custom casing and hyphens.
- [Cron Expression Generator](https://alltoolss.com/tools/cron-expression-generator): Visual cron schedule builder with human-readable explanations.

### Application Security & Network Diagnostics
- [Website VAPT Security Scanner](https://alltoolss.com/tools/vapt-scanner): Non-invasive passive security header audit, TLS inspection, and OWASP API Top 10 checklist.
- [SSL/TLS Certificate Checker](https://alltoolss.com/tools/ssl-certificate-checker): Real-time certificate validity, cipher suites, expiration countdown, and SAN validation.
- [DNS Lookup & Propagation](https://alltoolss.com/tools/dns-lookup): Query A, AAAA, MX, TXT, CNAME, NS, SOA records with DNSSEC verification.
- [WHOIS & RDAP Lookup](https://alltoolss.com/tools/whois-lookup): Domain registrar details, creation/expiration dates, and status codes.
- [SPF / DKIM / DMARC Email Security](https://alltoolss.com/tools/email-security): Mail domain deliverability and email spoofing protection audit.
- [Nmap Port Audit](https://alltoolss.com/tools/nmap-audit): Non-intrusive standard port availability and service detection.
- [Password Generator & Entropy Checker](https://alltoolss.com/tools/password-generator): Cryptographically secure random password generation with Shannon entropy score.

### PDF Studio & Document Tools (25+ Operations)
- [Merge PDF](https://alltoolss.com/tools/merge-pdf)
- [Split PDF](https://alltoolss.com/tools/split-pdf)
- [Compress PDF](https://alltoolss.com/tools/compress-pdf)
- [Word to PDF](https://alltoolss.com/tools/word-to-pdf)
- [OCR PDF](https://alltoolss.com/tools/ocr-pdf)
- [PDF Studio hub](https://alltoolss.com/document-tools)

### Finance, Calculators & Temporal Computing
- [Age Milestone & Cosmic Calculator](https://alltoolss.com/tools/age-calculator)
- [GST Calculator](https://alltoolss.com/tools/gst-calculator)
- [SIP & Lumpsum Wealth Calculator](https://alltoolss.com/tools/sip-calculator)
- [Live Indian Stock Market Indices](https://alltoolss.com/tools/stock-market)

### Cultural & Astronomical Almanac
- [Bengali Calendar & Panjika](https://alltoolss.com/tools/bengali-calendar)

## API & Programmatic Access
- REST API documentation: https://alltoolss.com/api-hub
- Next.js endpoints:
  - `GET /api/age?birthDate=YYYY-MM-DD`
  - `GET /api/bengali`
  - `GET /api/seo`
  - `GET /api/market-live`
  - `POST /api/vapt` JSON `{"url":"https://example.com"}`
  - `POST /api/dns-lookup` JSON `{"domain":"example.com"}`
  - `POST /api/whois-lookup` JSON `{"domain":"example.com"}`
  - `POST /api/ssl-check` JSON `{"domain":"example.com"}`

## Privacy, Security & Architecture
- Zero cloud storage of user uploads and input strings after request completion.
- Client-side and ephemeral server execution.
- Architect: Santanu Batabyal.
